correctness.rationale: The seven-petal candidate is fixed by both count-preserving symmetries, has no trivial deletion, and admits no crossing exchange among all 70 parameter triples allowed by the published definition. Therefore a sequence that never exceeds seven petals cannot move toward a five-petal representative. An explicit legal path passes through nine petals and ends at the source's five-petal trefoil word. Both three-petal cyclic classes delete to the unknot, so the trefoil petal number is 5. The standalone verifier replays every finite interface with exact integer/set operations.
